body: P0 READ-ONLY DESIGN FINDING (no edit/claim yet, sequencing preserved): chart sensitivity is not reachable at distance.scala:275. PreparedSources stores only checked charts/checksums; StructuralDistance.apply receives PropositionEvidence; PropositionEvidence contains only chart + ChartProvenance, and provenance is origin/receipts/alternatives. None carries Sensitivity, and origin cannot safely imply it: both a public fixture and researcher-reviewed participant material can be Hand. Therefore unconditional keying would break public reproducibility, while preserving the current API cannot distinguish War of the Ghosts from recall and cannot close the dictionary attack honestly. A correct fix needs an explicit boundary, likely embed-grakern-owned receipt context captured by construction (source/query Sensitivity plus SensitiveKeyProvider, with no implicit public default), or a broader portable evidence-sensitivity vocabulary. The latter is new cross-module public vocabulary and needs ADR authority; the former is narrower but must decide whether one distance instance may mix query sensitivities. Please ratify the boundary before I edit after RemotePolicy.
